paper_explanation: After retaining req0011, req0010 adds no recovery benefit. FlowState instead selects the shared ancestor req0001, whose incremental benefit at this step is confined to the other pending continuation. The resulting 2333.666 ms improvement supports redundancy-aware reallocation, not a claim that simultaneous gains on multiple branches caused this win.
